{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Skywalker'' to ''Raptor Squad'': we're docked. ''Blow'' the hatch.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to the members of Raptor Squad|<ref name="Drone Alone" />}}
'''Raptor Squad''' was a military unit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Founded shortly after the [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|Duel on Cloud City]], the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was under the command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and was comprised of [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Together, they participated in a [[Mission to steal hyperdrive components|mission]] to steal [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] components.
